training.cross_device_full_gradient_l2: Not directly computed; complete gradients remain on their original servers. Scalar norm/hash audits and cross-device loss results are exported.
Not directly computed; complete gradients remain on their original servers. Scalar norm/hash audits and cross-device loss results are exported.

matrix_timing_scope: PPU serial, no concurrent training by this experiment

matrix_candidate_effect.accuracy_vs_current_ppu_tf32: Exact coordinates and five confidences for all 18 cases
matrix_candidate_effect.timing_limitation: 1 warmup and 3 paired repeats per mode; screening only, small percent differences do not establish a robust gain.

training_confirmation.scope: Warm-cache PPU performance rerun after inference workers finished; 4 steps, no tensor audit overhead, last 3 timed. H100 matched full training baselines. Small sample performance evidence.

selected_integration.scope: Experimental real-training integration; original public forward and original IEEE backward retained.

route_identity.inference_scope: No backward executes in inference; existing forward implementation, precision and inputs are preserved. Final inference timing refers to existing public TF32; no candidate timings fabricated.

controls.scope: Ordered RNG and complete augmented input comparison; scalar audit only.

selected_integration.inference: Original public forward function preserved by identity; no new inference timing is fabricated.
selected_integration.rejected_combined_forward_reason: Serial 18-case screening found no stable inference gain and several regressions.
selected_integration.training_dispatch_scope: FlagGems TriAttention explicitly enabled and observed; global enable_flaggems=false, triangle_multiplicative=torch. No claim that all training MM/addmm/BMM dispatch to FlagGems.
selected_integration.training_sample_limit: 245-token Protenix-v2 only, 3 timed steps after 1 warmup; about 3% measured saving is preliminary, not a demonstrated steady-state guarantee.

audit.scope: Full model parameter gradients before clipping, and actual first optimizer update; tensors stay on original server.
Full model parameter gradients before clipping, and actual first optimizer update; tensors stay on original server.

zero_learning_rate_step0_update: DISCARDED as update-accuracy evidence. Only audit_step=1 with positive learning rate is valid.
